caption:
Some gradients in Costa Rica are not meant to be conquered in the saddle — they are walked, one deliberate breath at a time. High above the valley floor, the gravel yields to grass and the ridgeline asks for whatever patience your legs have left. The reward here is never speed; it is the quiet that settles when you finally crest the hill and see how far you have come.
